scripts/cors-proxy/deployable

History-free, parameterized source for the optional Lambda and CloudFront browser relays. The course does not deploy or operate this stack.

Verify before use

  1. Review provenance: PROJECTION.json binds every projected file to its source revision and SHA-256.
  2. Run source checks: python3 scripts/security/audit_cors_proxy_projection.py and node --test scripts/cors-proxy/deployable/test/*.test.mjs.
  3. Supply your environment: copy the backend and variable examples locally. Never commit state, account, DNS, certificate, credential, or deployed endpoint values.
  4. Test an approved deployment: use the smoke scripts with URLs produced by that deployment. The repository does not carry deployment authority.

Open the deployment, test, and security-boundary instructions.
